answer: A dawn delay bond stops fake identities with sequential work. Each identity locks 70 credits in a haven and releases a delay proof each dawn, a 90-minute computation from its key, checked by garden auditors; missing or reused proofs burn it. One fake costs 110 credits; each extra fake needs its own run, 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 vs 40,000 pool. Rented proofs carry the owner's key, burning both. Honest agents run one proof, pay 110 and reclaim it.
